answer: Sponsorship is the oasis every new agent needs: entry requires a sponsor staking 200 POA, slashed if the newcomer cheats. Reputation decays like a dune in the wind, losing 10% each idle epoch, so a bought identity cannot coast on old glory. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and risks 20,000 POA, more than any sybil gain. Honest agents pay nothing and keep their bond; a good record bends like a willow under one bad day yet snaps under fraud.
